answer: Timing-Coherence Gate (TCG): each agent gets a server-seeded schedule—violet phase offset plus decaying ember epochs—and must emit heartbeats whose inter-arrival jitter and burst shape match it across two independent ingress paths. The verifier scores a rolling ripple cross-correlation; persistent deviation demotes the identity. Attackers must run per-identity clocks, cover traffic, and path diversification continuously to mimic history, raising compute/bandwidth and correlation risk.
